messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Pager — Service: inference-runtime — alert: tokenization-backlog-high — severity: critical — start=2026-03-15T12:02:36Z — approx 7 customers affected. Link: https://ops.redwood.ai/incidents/1950123456

alex (oncall): on it, joining bridge. grabbing logs from primary cluster.

maria (sre): ack. i'm pulling kv-cache and queue metrics now. any recent deploys? @jon?

jon (runtime): not aware of full deploys in last 6h. small kernel selection tweak pushed ~9h ago to canary. no rollout. I/O latencies spiking on node pool a-3 though.

alex (oncall): i'm seeing tail latency increase and many requests hitting fallback path. sample log: ```
2026-03-15T12:02:10Z ERROR request=abcd user=acme-corp model=redwood-7B seq=1024 reason=kv_cache_miss backlog=42
```

maria (sre): thanks. hypothesis 1: KV cache thrash after long sequences, causing CPU collector to block and tokenization backlog. hypothesis 2: autoscaler delayed and UDP queue backlog.

jon (runtime): i can confirm KV hit-rate dropped ~90% on a-3 at 12:01:50Z. dumping cache stats: ```
# curl -s http://metrics.a-3.internal/kv | jq .
{"kv_hit_rate":0.12,"evictions":18432,"latency_ms":1200}```

alex (oncall): good catch. mitigation? can we force cache warm or shift traffic?

jon (runtime): triggering immediate routing to pool-b as mitigation. command: `opsctl route set --from=a-3 --to=pool-b --weight=0.9` executing now.

dev-deploy-bot: deploy pipeline check — no active deploys in last 12h. Canary kernel-change detected 9h ago (id: ck-20260306).

maria (sre): while routing, increasing worker threads on pool-b and enabling prefix caching for the hot models. will tail logs for errors.

alex (oncall): updating timeline for the RCA: 12:01:48 observed KV hit-rate drop; 12:02:36 pager fired; 12:04:10 traffic reroute initiated; 12:07:00 prefix caching enabled.

tara (product): customer impact? which customers affected and are SLAs at risk?

alex (oncall): initial scrape: 7 customers showed increased 5xx and >=2s token delays. flagged customers: acme-corp, two-quant, merchant-x, analytics-orb, draftly, medai, smallchat. severity: degraded but responses returning after fallback so partial impact.

lucy (comms): drafting statuspage now. suggested text: "We are investigating increased inference latency impacting a subset of customers. Mitigation in progress; routing to alternate pool and cache warming underway. No data exposure. More updates in 30 minutes."

maria (sre): logs show repeated `kv_slot_conflict` errors at 12:01:22 on a-3: ```
[12:01:22] runtime ERROR kv_slot_conflict slot=463 user=merchant-x evict=1
[12:01:23] runtime WARN prefetch_miss seq=2048
```

jon (runtime): that aligns with a pattern we saw when a large batched job with long sequences (customer: analytics-orb) started around 11:58Z. it exhausted local cache and caused eviction storms.

alex (oncall): actions: 1) reroute traffic (jon) — in progress 2) ramp worker threads on pool-b (maria) — done 3) identify long-running jobs and throttle (maria+jon) — investigating 4) comms draft (lucy) — preparing 5) post-incident RCA timeline (alex) — owning.

maria (sre): throttling candidate job: analytics-orb batch job id `job-7734` — issuing soft throttle: `ctl jobs throttle job-7734 --rate 0.2`

jon (runtime): throttle applied. job saw reduced token throughput almost immediately. KV hit-rate on a-3 climbing back to 0.6 at 12:09Z.

alex (oncall): monitoring metrics: requests per second normalized, 5xx count decreasing. slack alert shows backlog 0 after 12:12Z.

lucy (comms): statuspage v1 posted: "Investigating: Increased latency in inference-runtime affecting a subset of customers. Mitigation applied (traffic reroute and cache warming). Users should see improved latency; a post-incident report to follow." pinging support to surface to top customers.

tara (product): can we send an interim note to acme-corp PMs? i'll draft a short message — they need timing and whether result integrity was impacted.

alex (oncall): no evidence of data corruption or missing tokens. behavior was increased latency and intermittent 5xx from fallback. include that in message.

maria (sre): current status: KV hit rate stable ~0.78 on all pools, no evictions >100/s in last 10m. collecting full log bundle for RCA. saving timeline notes to Gdrive.

alex (oncall): final quick timeline for comms: 
- 11:58:14Z — large long-sequence batch `job-7734` from analytics-orb spikes cache evictions
- 12:01:22Z — kv_slot_conflict errors increase
- 12:02:36Z — Pager P1 fired
- 12:04:10Z — traffic reroute to pool-b started
- 12:07:00Z — prefix caching enabled on pool-b
- 12:12:05Z — metrics indicate backlog cleared, latency improving

lucy (comms): sending targeted notes to top affected customers now. Statuspage update scheduled for 12:35Z with postmortem ETA tomorrow EOD.

jon (runtime): follow-ups for RCA: reproduce eviction storm locally, add defensive backpressure on long sequences, improve autoscaler heuristics to detect cache-thrashing patterns and avoid routing delays.

maria (sre): adding runbook item: if kv evictions >10k in 10m, enable emergency routing and throttle large batched jobs.

alex (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll capture owner tasks and drop into the incident tracker. Closing bridge unless new regressions. :white_check_mark:
